title: Private VPC Quick Actions / Command Palette prototype
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a keyboard-first Quick Actions (command palette) to accelerate common Private/VPC console tasks (network troubleshoot, cluster snapshots, rollbacks, key rotation, cost quick-snapshot). The pattern should be discoverable, permission-aware, and safe by default for sensitive operations.
context: Private console users frequently perform repetitive operational tasks across clusters and VPCs; current flows require multiple clicks and navigation across pages.
Goal is to provide a low-friction overlay that reduces time-to-triage and standardizes safe confirmations for destructive actions.
Must respect RBAC, link to audit logs, and surface cost/latency impact previews for actions that may change routing or capacity.
We want an incremental rollout: opt-in in alpha for platform engineers, then broader beta if telemetry shows reduced mean time to task completion and no accidental actions.
goals: Create a keyboard-first command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) for Private console scoped to tenant/clusters/VPCs
Make actions permission-aware and show required role/scopes inline
Preview implications for operational actions (cost delta, estimated downtime window) before execution
Ensure every action is linked to audit trails, related runbooks, and relevant dashboards
user_stories: As an on-call engineer, I want to open a palette and jump directly to viewing the last 10 audit logs for a cluster so I can triage faster
As a platform admin, I want to kick off a cluster rollback from one place and see the predicted impact so I can make an informed call
As an SRE I want to rotate tenant network keys with an inline confirmation modal and a link to the KMS rotation log
As a product admin I want quick access to a cost snapshot for a tenant before approving an upgrade
decisions: Use an overlay command palette (centered, dismissible with Esc) rather than a persistent sidebar to preserve screen real estate in dense ops pages
Only show actions the current user has permission to execute; display greyed out actions with tooltip explaining missing permission rather than hiding them entirely
For destructive actions, require an explicit confirmation step and show a short rollback runbook link in confirmation modal

Surface a lightweight cost/latency preview for actions that modify capacity or routing; the preview will be derived from the Optimize service API (estimate tokens) rather than real-time allocation to keep latency low
feedback: 2026-02-26 - PM review (Jules Nguyen): love the shortcut, asked to include cost snapshot for capacity changes
2026-03-01 - Eng review (Mateo Ruiz): raised concern about long-running API calls for cost previews; suggested cached estimates and a 'refresh' hint
2026-03-04 - Security (Priya Shah): asked for audit-log linkage and explicit KMS permission requirement for key rotation action
2026-03-09 - Accessibility review (Samir Khan): requested focus management for keyboard nav, announce overlay on open, and clear labels for truncated action names
review_notes: Prototype tested with 6 internal SREs during hallway usability session: avg time to complete 'rotate key' task fell from 4.2m to 1.1m
One false-positive accidental 'scale down' click occurred in an early build; design update added secondary confirmation if the previewed downtime > 0
Telemetry plan: add events qactions.open, qactions.action_selected, qactions.confirm, qactions.cancel, qactions.permission_denied to measure discovery and safety
UX trade-off: showing greyed actions increases discoverability but may surface sensitive actions to users; mitigated by tooltip text and audit linking
acceptance_criteria: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the overlay on all Private console pages and focuses the text input
Actions list is filtered in real-time and grouped by category (Network, Cluster, Cost, Admin)
Actions the user lacks permission for are visible but disabled with clear permission hint
Selecting an action shows a concise preview (cost delta, estimated latency/downtime, related runbook) before allowing execution
All executed actions create an entry in the tenant audit log with a link back from the confirmation screen
Automated keyboard-accessibility checks pass (focus trap, ARIA attributes, screen-reader announce)
next_steps: Ship alpha feature-flagged to 10 internal tenants for 2 weeks and collect telemetry
Build lightweight server endpoint for approximate cost/latency previews (cache-based) - Eng ticket ENG-93451
Add backend audit-link surface field to action API (security review, Priya)
Prepare release notes and admin opt-out switch in Dedicated settings
